title: Bruce Lee
build: Remember crack of the Datasoft disk; the game calls itself REV.2 ($4707); one load, start-up block moved to $0400

tools.widget tests: node 22.23.4: the Music tab's player checked write for write against the game's own code in kit/c64/machine.js (test_music.js); the extra-fall test run on add_score in kit/cpu/cpu6502.js
tools.subagents: one checking agent for the 60-verify sample, claude-opus-5-5; one web-reading agent for the reviews

accuracy.note: Sonnet annotated the Bronze run's routines; Opus checked and rewrote them and annotated the rest to 100 %

exclude: zero-page variables: run-time state, named and described in the listing
the noise table: 256 samples of the SID's voice-3 noise taken at start-up, which the random reader steps through
the waiting player's room-visit and lantern bytes, swapped in and out at each change of player ($0FA8, $0FE6)
the saved port directions and the protection result, written while the game runs
the moving hazard's setting, changed by the room routines
the two fireballs' state: on/off, waits, X and Y
screen row tables built by $0869, the scores and falls of both players, and scratch words, all written at run time
the room colours saved while the idle pause cycles them
the current room's raster lines, copied each frame by $48C1
the bonus-fall counts and room counters, written by the room routines
work tables: the actors' step queues, frames and touch tables, the mines' state
the two sprite buffers, drawn each frame by build_sprites
a copy of the first 512 bytes of the character ROM and their inverses, made at start-up for the score band; ROM bytes, not the game's
the screen at $8C00 and the sprite pointers at $8FF8
the outline shapes built at start-up by $513B over the packed character sets that $0494 had already expanded to $A000-$BFFF; $9FC0-$9FFF is left over
more outline shapes built at start-up, and the outline buffer $CAE0-$CB7F
